name: Three Village Home Watch
sub: Documented home checks while you're away

hero.alt: White colonial home with a red maple in the front yard in autumn

ticker: Bonded and insured for home watch
Home watch is our only business

intro.text: Three Village Home Watch gives seasonal residents, snowbirds and frequent travelers on Long Island's North Shore peace of mind while they're away. Owner Tony Saunders performs regular, documented visual inspections of your home, checking for signs of intrusion, pest activity, water damage, weather damage, HVAC failures and other issues before they become expensive problems.

gallery.alt: Tony Saunders receiving his NHWA Certified Home Watch Professional recognition

services.d: Documented visual inspections of your home or property while you're away.
Signs of intrusion, pests, water damage, weather damage, HVAC failures and other issues.
Available outside business hours for an additional fee.
For homes in the Hamptons, North Fork or elsewhere in the US and Canada, referrals to other NHWA-accredited companies.

advantage.text: It's not a side service tacked onto property management or cleaning. Three Village Home Watch is fully bonded and insured specifically for home watch work, is an Accredited Member of the National Home Watch Association, and Tony is an NHWA Certified Home Watch Professional.

reviews.text: A quick review helps your neighbors find home watch they can count on.

faq: A visual inspection of a home or property, looking for obvious issues, while the owner is away.

Stony Brook, Setauket, East Setauket, Old Field, Poquott, Port Jefferson, Port Jefferson Station, Belle Terre, St. James, Head of the Harbor, Nissequogue, Mt. Sinai, Lake Grove, Terryville and nearby North Shore communities.

final.t: Away for the season? *We'll keep watch.*
final.text: Call Tony or send a message to get started.
